name: live-tabs
description: Browser-style workspace tabs with kept-alive pages for TanStack Router. Switch pages without losing scroll, form input, or query state.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @live-tabs/core && npm run build -w @live-tabs/tanstack-router && npm run build -w @live-tabs/next && npm run build -w live-tabs
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @live-tabs/core && npm run build -w @live-tabs/tanstack-router && npm run build -w @live-tabs/next && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.lint:pkg: npm run build && npm run lint:pkg --workspaces --if-present
